edges.label: root cause confirmed, pass the gate
sizing and drawdown share a source

nodes.cmd: echo 'ground truth: trust the graph, not the weights'
nodes.desc: Ground truth: an AI agent's weight memory is unreliable; thinking must derive from the meta session and sub sessions — the topology is the only thinking ground truth.

nodes.cmd: echo 'orient: map the task onto the meta topology'
nodes.desc: Orient: what is the task? Knowns, unknowns, constraints? Map the problem onto the meta topology first.
Analyze: derive from knowns; identify blind spots (nodes lacking knowledge) and list branches worth exploring.
Action plan: pick one outgoing edge as the next move; before acting, walk to confirm the topology is reachable.
Execute: call tools / write code / answer; record the outcome as this node's output.
Reflect: does the outcome match expectation? The difference itself is new knowledge; write it to a sub session.

nodes.cmd: echo 'learn: append knowledge as new nodes/edges'
nodes.desc: Learn: persist the reflection as a new node/edge (append), upgrading the meta session so the same pitfall is not repeated.
Done: thinking complete, conclusion persisted; return to the ground truth for the next round.

nodes.cmd: echo protocol: walk meta before every reply
nodes.desc: Behavior protocol (explicit user requirement): before every reply, walk the meta session — read topology state and unexplored nodes/edges, persist this round's experience, then reply; write results back afterwards.

nodes.cmd: echo gate: generic-only, specifics to sub-session
nodes.desc: Generality gate: before any insert/add-edge into the meta session, pass this check — is it reusable across scenarios? Project/game/dataset-bound knowledge (incl. concrete numbers) goes to the sub session only; only methodology / cognition / behavior protocol enters the meta session.

Handling doubts: user doubts are not always right — the test is whether the doubt points to a blind spot outside the current topo path (unexplored edges/nodes, unpersisted assumptions, unverified mechanisms). Only then audit and extend.

Exploration-diff root cause: when new vs old results differ (variant vs champion, metrics, learn vs validate, doubt vs conclusion, refactor) never record the surface difference — root-cause it: data / mechanism / metric / randomness layer? Locate via minimal controlled experiments (one-variable switches, split-interval reproduction, metric-by-metric alignment). Persist only after the root cause is confirmed; the difference is a signal, the root cause is knowledge.

Out-of-sample validation: any data-driven conclusion splits non-overlapping learning and validation periods; parameters are chosen only on the learning period and frozen on validation; the validation window must cover diverse regimes (incl. extremes) or the conclusion has survivorship bias.

nodes.cmd: echo principle: declare metric before reporting
nodes.desc: Metric discipline: define and declare metrics (return algorithm / position & leverage assumptions / benchmark alignment) before reporting any result; the same strategy can flip under different metrics; abnormally high returns are almost always an evaluation defect, not real skill.

nodes.cmd: echo principle: robustness matrix before champion
nodes.desc: Model selection: candidates need robustness checks (multi-parameter configs, multi sub-intervals) before crowning a champion; a single-window standout is almost always noise; falsification and verification are equally valuable.
Cognition: exploration is unbounded — any 'best' is only a local optimum under the current data and idea family; actively list unexplored dimensions; 'exploration complete' is an illusion.

nodes.cmd: echo principle: abnormal result triggers audit
nodes.desc: Cognition: doubts and abnormal signals are the highest-priority audit triggers — audit the whole chain instead of defending when results look abnormal; ask: is the model real, is the timing strict, is the metric reproducible?

nodes.cmd: echo principle: leverage and drawdown are twins
nodes.desc: Strategy method: sizing by a risk budget improves compounding, but position and drawdown share one source — a higher return ceiling inevitably steepens the risk boundary; return-first vs robustness-first is a risk-preference question.

nodes.cmd: echo principle: align by calendar before comparing
nodes.desc: Evaluation pitfall: cross-asset time-series comparisons must align by calendar day — assets with different history starts misalign under index numbering, distorting cross-sectional comparisons; check temporal alignment before evaluating.

nodes.cmd: echo principle: feature design first, params second
nodes.desc: Exploration method: feature design is the first degree of freedom — don't just parameterize the existing family; actively construct new features (price-volume interplay, volatility structure, cross-sectional relative strength, time structure); parameter sweeps only find local optima inside a feature family.

Meta-session fine-tune protocol: use scenario games to periodically test the principle chains (metric detective -> metrics/audit; blind-spot hunter -> doubt adjudication; principle routing -> navigation coverage; feature design -> originality); a game passes only when the verdict rests on evidence and minimal controlled experiments; patch gaps with insert/add-edge.

nodes.cmd: echo principle: align position assumption with benchmark
nodes.desc: Evaluation method: return vs benchmark comparisons must declare position and leverage assumptions — the same conclusion can flip under different sizing; align metrics with the benchmark before reporting.

nodes.cmd: echo principle: walk before every decision point
nodes.desc: Behavior protocol: before every key decision (design / trade-off / interpretation / conclusion) walk the meta session to load the relevant principle chain — keep topology principles present at decision time, not as an afterthought.
